question: The International Day of Innocent Children Victims of Aggression is commemorated each year on ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**4 June.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **United Nations (UN) International Day of Innocent Children Victims of Aggression **is mentioned on **4 June** every year. 
 
• The aim of the day is to **recognize the pain bear by children** throughout the world who are the sufferer of** physical, mental and emotional abuse.**
 
• This day declares the **UN's commitment to saving the rights of children.**
 
• The word** “child victim”** has, as mentioned above, been explained to describe** children and adolescents, under the age of 18, who are victims of crime.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 24 of the Indian constitution** clearly mentions that **"No child below the age of fourteen years shall be employed to work in any factory or mine or employed in any hazardous employment."** 
 
• According to the** 1929 Act,** the marriage of **girls below the age of 14 years and boys below the age of 18 years was banned.**
 
• **POCSO Act, 2012 **was started when the cases of **sexual abuse against children rose up**.​
